subject: Geopolitics
title: Citizen Journalism in War Zones
description: One-minute skill: Citizen Journalism in War Zones.

hook.text: A Syrian baker filmed his bombed neighborhood with a phone. The footage reached 20 million people.

discovery.text: Citizen journalism documented atrocities in Syria, Myanmar, and Ethiopia that professional journalists couldn't reach.

twist.text: Citizen footage is unverified by default. Armed groups stage events for cameras. Not every viral video tells the truth.

climax.text: Citizen journalism democratized war reporting. It exposed truths and spread lies alike. Verification is the challenge.

punchline.text: Everyone can report. Not everyone can verify.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge of citizen journalism?
options: Citizens lack smartphones to record events
Footage is unverified and can include staged events
Professional journalists always cover every conflict
